about_lib_electron_desc: Packages this app as a cross-platform desktop app.
about_lib_pillow_desc: Loads and resizes covers and backgrounds.
about_lib_pyinstaller_desc: Packages this app into a standalone .exe.
about_lib_pystray_desc: Powers the system tray icon and status dot.
about_lib_python_desc: The language this app is written in.
about_lib_react_desc: The UI library used to build every screen.
about_lib_tkinter_desc: The UI toolkit used for every window and widget.
about_lib_typescript_desc: Adds type safety on top of JavaScript.
about_lic_free_commercial: Free for any use, including commercial
about_lic_gpl_bootloader: GPL-licensed bootloader; doesn't license your own script
about_license_disclaimer: License details are as commonly published by each project; check their official pages for the full, current text.
about_tagline: v{{version}} — a cozy, offline, manual reading timer for your bookshelf.
chk_enable_tray: Enable tray icon (sage = reading, rose = paused)
confirm_already_finished_msg:
'{{name}}' is already marked finished.
Update the finish date to today?
confirm_delete_msg: Delete '{{name}}' and its tracked time? This cannot be undone.
confirm_mark_finished_msg:
Mark '{{name}}' as finished?
The timer will stop and this will show up in the Library Log.
confirm_reset_time_msg: Reset tracked reading time for '{{name}}' to zero?
dlg_add_time_desc: Add time you read elsewhere — another app, a physical stopwatch, or anywhere else the timer here didn't cover.
dlg_customize_colors_desc: Pick a color for each part of the UI
empty_no_books: No books on your shelf yet — click + Add Book
err_add_time_empty: Enter at least some time to add.
err_already_running_msg:
BookRunners is already open.
Check your system tray, or close the existing window before opening another.
err_missing_dep_bg_msg:
Custom backgrounds need Pillow.
Install with: pip install pillow
err_missing_dep_covers_msg:
Custom covers need Pillow.
Install with: pip install pillow
hint_note_example: e.g. Read on my phone at the airport
hint_right_click: Right-click a book on the shelf for more options
info_nice_read_msg:
'{{name}}' marked as finished.
Check the Library Log for your stats.
label_status_snapshot: Set on {{date}} — {{time}} read at the time.
legacy_import_found_msg: Found {{count}} books ({{time}} tracked) from your previous BookRunners install. Import them into Book Runners?
note_applies_on_save: Applies instantly when you hit Save.
note_choose_language: Choose your preferred language for the app.
note_font_timer:
Timer digits stay monospaced for alignment.
Applies instantly when you hit Save.
note_startup_exe_only: Only works from the built .exe, not the .py script
note_tray_behavior:
When enabled, closing the window (X) hides it to the tray
instead of quitting. Use 'Quit' in the tray's right-click menu to exit fully.
update_ready_msg: The update has been downloaded. Restart Book Runners to install it.
warn_already_exists_msg: A book with that title already exists.
